name: Piaggio MP3
engine: 244 to 530 cc liquid-cooled single, fuel injected, CVT, two front wheels
intro: Piaggio's tilting three-wheeler. Two front wheels on a parallelogram, with a tilt lock to service.

L: The front tilting linkage has bushings and bearings of its own. Check for play before you trust the steering.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
